{"path": "/results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_1/melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Silicon NPT melting simulation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_1/structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# Compute temperature and pressure
compute mytemp all temp
compute mypress all pressure mytemp

# Initial velocities at 300K
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT ensemble with Nose-Hoover thermostat and barostat
# Tdamp = 100*timestep = 0.1 ps, Pdamp = 1000*timestep = 1.0 ps
fix npt_heating all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# Dump trajectory
dump traj all custom 1000 /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_true/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_subtask_melting_trial_1/trajectory.lammpstrj id type x y z
